messages:
brightpay-support: Hey all — since last night's rollout ~10% of BrightPay invoices are failing our JSON parser. We saw no errors on our side, just a syntax error when parsing the response. Example below (redacted).
samantha.cs: Sorry to hear that — can you paste a raw response and the request id? Is this only in prod or also in canary? :thinking_face:
brightpay-support: Here's a minimal raw response we captured (request-id: rp_94ab):
```
{"invoice_id":"inv_985","total":134.50,"items":[{"sku":"A12","qty":1}]}Confidence: 0.41
```
Note the JSON is valid then the text "Confidence: 0.41" is appended on the same line. Our parser chokes because it's not delimited.
jonas.sre: That looks like a post-processing append. Any idea which model variant/route that request hit? region eu-west-1?
brightpay-support: Yes, eu-west-1, route=invoice-json, model=v2.3.1-canary. Only started after the deploy at 2025-03-10 23:40 UTC.
alyssa.eng-ml: I can reproduce locally — when the model is uncertain about whether extra commentary is needed, our output formatter adds an analysis string but I missed adding a newline separator when confidence text is present. That must have slipped into the canary. :grimacing:
repro-bot: Repro steps posted:
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"route":"invoice-json","prompt":"<invoice items>"}'
2) watch for responses that contain JSON immediately followed by free text (no newline).
Example response captured:
```
{"invoice_id":"inv_985","items":[],"total":0}Confidence: 0.12
```
ben.product: Can we mitigate for customers quickly? BrightPay is blocked in production parsing.
samantha.cs: For short-term CS workaround: suggest BrightPay strip trailing non-JSON suffix before parse or run a tolerant parser that extracts the first balanced JSON object. But we need a platform fix asap.
alyssa.eng-ml: Agreed. Short-term patch: update the output formatter to always append "

" before any free-text analysis. Medium-term: enforce schema validation in the generation pipeline and return an explicit wrapper when confidence is low, e.g., `{"_analysis": "..."}` separated from the payload field.
jonas.sre: I'll roll a hotfix canary for route=invoice-json in eu-west-1 to add the newline. Rolling now and will monitor errors. cc @alyssa.eng-ml
brightpay-support: Thanks — we can flip to tolerant parsing but prefer a platform-side fix. We'll stand by to validate after hotfix.
samantha.cs: Created tracking ticket CS-3381 and assigned to eng-ml + sre. Action items:
- jonas.sre: hotfix rollout (eu-west-1) — in progress
- alyssa.eng-ml: PR to enforce newline + schema validator in formatter — target EOD
- brightpay-support: will test after hotfix and report results
Please add any further reproduction logs here.
alyssa.eng-ml: PR opened: https://git.redwood.ai/eng-ml/formatter/pulls/42 — includes tests for trailing-comment handling and a schema gate. Will add a release note.
jonas.sre: Hotfix rolled to 50% canary in eu-west-1 at 1758888900, errors rate dropped to ~1.2% from 9.8% in first 20 minutes. Continuing ramp. :thumbsup:
brightpay-support: Confirming — we saw successful parses for the last 12 requests. Will watch for 30m and then mark resolved if stable.
samantha.cs: Thanks everyone. Marking thread for follow-up once PR merged and full rollout complete. :white_check_mark:
